INTJ.name: The Architect
INTJ.description:
Strong at drawing the big picture and setting long-term direction. Based on penetrating insight and systematic thinking, they contemplate the most efficient path to achieve goals.

With high execution and concentration, they silently maintain the standards they set for themselves. However, perfectionist tendencies and high expectations may create gaps in pace with others or miss emotional signals. Sometimes practicing flexibility in the process can be helpful.

INTP.name: The Thinker
INTP.description:
Enjoys breaking down and reconstructing ideas, exploring logic and principles. With high curiosity, they dig deep when encountering new concepts and theories.

While strong at presenting creative solutions, execution may be delayed due to a tendency to keep options open, and they may struggle with prioritization. Connecting ideas to reality through small experiments and quick feedback loops makes their strengths shine even more.

ENTJ.name: The Commander
ENTJ.description:
Excels at setting clear goals and organizing resources for quick execution. Skilled at structuring and prioritizing, they often take leadership roles, leading teams to achieve results.

However, direct communication and high standards can sometimes feel burdensome. Coordinating the rhythm of relationships along with performance enhances team sustainability.

ENTP.name: The Debater
ENTP.description:
Finds joy in discovering and experimenting with new possibilities. Quickly connects various perspectives to present innovative ideas, and thoughts become clearer through discussion.

On the other hand, interest may wane in routine tasks and detailed execution. Collaborating with partners who can make ideas actually work, or supplementing execution with short-cycle goals improves balance.

INFJ.name: The Advocate
INFJ.description:
Values meaning and seeks to create positive change for people and communities. Though quiet, they grasp essence through deep insight and provide direction with long-term vision.

High empathy and responsibility can easily lead to self-exhaustion. Setting healthy boundaries and securing time for self-care ensures authentic influence continues steadily.

INFP.name: The Mediator
INFP.description:
Stays true to authenticity and values, finding meaning in relationships and experiences. Rich in imagination and sensitivity, they view the world with a warm perspective and express creativity in their own way.

Sometimes constraints of reality or conflict situations can feel burdensome. Setting small execution goals and practicing honest communication can gently connect inner values with reality.

ENFJ.name: The Protagonist
ENFJ.description:
Excels at putting people at the center and gathering team energy. Helps others grow by discovering their strengths and shares vision persuasively.

Caring nature may lead to putting oneself last. Clarifying expectations and limits while maintaining rest rhythms allows leadership to spread longer and wider.

ENFP.name: The Campaigner
ENFP.description:
Inspires people by finding new possibilities. With flexible and warm communication, they brighten the atmosphere and expand their own path through diverse experiences.

Execution may slow when interest wanes. Maintaining momentum by breaking favorite elements into small pieces for routines or setting deadlines and feedback with colleagues.

ISTJ.name: The Logistician
ISTJ.description:
Highly responsible and trusted for keeping promises to the end. Makes judgments based on facts and data, producing best results in orderly and stable environments.

May experience stress in frequently changing or ambiguous situations. Sharing reasons for change and expected effects in advance, and trying gradually makes adaptation much easier.

ISFJ.name: The Protector
ISFJ.description:
Provides steady support to surroundings through detailed care and consistency. Offers practical help generously and builds trust through quiet dedication.

Tends to put own needs last, making fatigue accumulation easy. Practicing polite refusal and creating small self-care routines completes sustainable care.

ESTJ.name: The Executive
ESTJ.description:
Leads organizations and projects stably with clear standards and procedures. Strong in execution and management, clarifies responsibilities and focuses on goal achievement.

Quick decisions and direct feedback can sometimes feel overwhelming. Sharing decision backgrounds and allowing time for input increases both trust and speed.

ESFJ.name: The Consul
ESFJ.description:
Good at sensing changes in people's moods and creating comfortable environments for everyone. Values tradition and trust, carefully tending to relationships.

Trying too hard to meet others' expectations may lead to neglecting oneself. Allowing the same kindness to oneself and naturally practicing asking for help creates healthier harmony.

ISTP.name: The Virtuoso
ISTP.description:
Strong at practical problem-solving, enjoys learning by touching and testing directly. Calm and flexible, quickly finds solutions even in unexpected situations.

Interest may decrease in long-term planning or repetitive routines. Maintaining autonomy while setting small milestones and measurable goals increases sense of achievement.

ISFP.name: The Adventurer
ISFP.description:
Rich in sensitivity, captures beauty in daily life with a warm perspective. Values present experiences and expresses themselves authentically in their own way.

Avoidance of conflict may bury opinions. Practicing honest expression in comfortable language improves relationship balance.

ESTP.name: The Entrepreneur
ESTP.description:
Quick situation judgment and excellent action skills solve problems immediately. Large energy and presence inject vitality into teams.

Risk-enjoying tendencies may underestimate long-term risks. Preparing safety measures through checklists and prior agreements makes strengths stand out more.

ESFP.name: The Entertainer
ESFP.description:
Finds great joy in moments with people and has talent for brightening atmosphere anywhere. Rich senses enable creating enjoyable experiences.

Plans may become loose as interests shift. Maintaining fun elements while using simple schedule management and commitments with colleagues adds consistency.

compatibility.defaultPros: You can respect each other's different perspectives and learn new viewpoints.
compatibility.defaultCons: Understanding may be difficult initially due to personality differences.
